hooks.name: player_item_held
hooks.neoforge: none (NeoForge has no such event; Bukkit's PlayerItemHeldEvent)

rust_summary: A server player's selected hotbar slot, cancellable (`native_player_item_held`).
doc_summary: A server player selected a different hotbar slot: `native_player_item_held(player, name, from_slot, to_slot, cancel)` is called after the slot range check and before the selected slot changes. Set `cancel` to keep the old slot; the client is sent that slot again. The player's state is not swapped in, so helpers that look them up through `self.lan` may find nothing while a guest packet is handled. Bundles need "hooks": @API:player_item_held@.
